summary: Manufacture dialog dereferences an empty recipe slot
author: pm
body:
dialog_box_manufacture.cpp dereferences get_display_list()[m_progress] with no null check in the waiting, in-progress and done modes (:367, :373, :488, :494, :610, :616 as of 2026-11-24). The client agent crashed its client when it forced the done state with made-up values on a character with no recipes (measured). The reviewer found that the list is a fixed std::array, so the index cannot run out of range, but a slot can be null: build_item_manager.cpp:44-46 resets display slots on a rebuild, so a slot cleared while the dialog is open dereferences null (derived; not reproduced in normal play).

**Done when:** those modes check the slot and close or go back to the list when it is empty, with no crash in a forced test.

Source: HH-0066 batch 6 agent report and review, 2026-11-24.
